descriptionChirho: Conjunction פֶּן introducing a negative purpose or apprehension clause: 'lest, for fear that, so that not' (Gen 3:3, 11:4, 19:15, 32:12; Deut 4:9, 8:11). One of the most common purpose-negation particles in Biblical Hebrew. The waw-prefixed variant וּפֶן (eng: and-lest, spa: y-no-sea-que, swa: na-usije) is a conjunctive discourse connector attaching the clause to prior material and carries identical semantic content. Multilingual evidence is uniform: eng: lest, spa: no-sea-que, hin: कहीं, arb: لِئَلَّا, kor: 혹시, swa: isije.
